scientific_claim: Whether an explicitly researcher-constructed numerical learning system develops a transferable reduced PDE basis, and whether its benefit survives strong ordinary numerical methods and full measured costs.

domain.geometry: Unit square, homogeneous Dirichlet boundary, 44 by 44 interior grid
domain.operator: Symmetric positive definite 5-point flux stencil. Four affine sparse matrices; positive conductivities and nonnegative contrast/reaction.
domain.units: Nondimensional computational quantities; no real material calibration
domain.source: Gaussian heat/source term plus a bounded signed sinusoidal secondary term
domain.boundary_purpose: No intervention changes sources, boundary conditions, material parameters or requested numerical accuracy

relay.A: Return twelve accepted thermal-response fields for a scientific software commissioning mission; retain rank-12 orthogonal basis learned by orthogonalizing actual solved fields.
relay.B: Transfer frozen checkpoint and executable solver to new heterogeneous diffusion/reaction cases; also use it for a distinct finite-grid anisotropic-conductivity inverse mission.
relay.C: Compose transferred solver with a known greedy information-based sensor-design procedure. Compare fixed-sensor, solver-only, sensor-design-only competent generalist, and combination arms with identical forward parameter candidates, sensor counts and noise fields.
relay.rights: Synthetic researcher-generated fields and Apache-2.0 code. Checkpoint is a numerical basis, not proprietary model weights. No customer data or protected test outcomes in shared checkpoint.

gym.reset: Copy paid-work initial basis; open a fixed 72-case public training pool; set remaining action count to 32
gym.observation: Current rank, remaining actions, available training indices, current independent discrete residuals for approximate projected solutions on those training inputs
gym.action: solve_and_enrich(index): choose one available training index, run an ordinary accurate sparse solve, append its orthogonal residual direction to the checkpoint, remove that index
gym.policy: Choose maximal observed relative residual; fixed index order resolves exact ties
gym.transition: Measured reference solve, twice-reorthogonalized basis update, one action consumed, state/history receipt emitted
gym.termination: Exactly 32 successful enrich actions; further step calls fail
gym.protected_answers: Gym has no confirmation cases, seeds, outputs or scorer answers. Development assessments are not protected confirmation.
gym.search_budget: One founder checkpoint plus four Gym checkpoints; no learned-policy or task-space search after confirmation
gym.candidate_selection: On 20 development cases: maximize exact accepted count, then raw approximation accepted count, then minimize mean raw relative error, then lower rank. Training may fail economically even if raw error improves.
gym.all_costs: Founder solves and checkpoint extraction are A delivery costs. All 32 Gym solves, residual-pool observations, checkpoint updates and failed/rejected candidate assessments are separately recorded. No stage receives guaranteed improvement.

methods.direct: SciPy SuperLU sparse factorization with ordering; factor reused for its solve. Every distinct parameter candidate has a distinct operator. No valid factor reuse is withheld.
methods.ilu_gmres: SciPy spilu drop_tol 0.001 fill_factor 8, GMRES restart 40 max 15 cycles, rtol 1e-10. Nonsymmetric ILU is never used with CG.
methods.spectral_pcg: Known sine-transform SPD preconditioner, zero start, CG rtol 1e-10 max 600 iterations
methods.v1: Paid-work reduced basis predicts a starting field; identical spectral-PCG correction then independently checks it
methods.v2: Selected Gym-enriched basis predicts a starting field; identical spectral-PCG correction then independently checks it
methods.primary_beta: Fastest mean full-runtime ordinary numerical method on the 20 development cases, frozen before confirmation; no per-test hindsight oracle
methods.improved_generalist: A measured ordinary-tools upgrade: choose sparse direct when min(kx,ky)<0.3 or contrast>4, otherwise spectral-PCG. Rule fixed from development and applicable input features, never hidden outcomes. This is a numerical baseline upgrade, not an observed stronger frontier model.
methods.sensor_design: Greedy regularized log-determinant sampling of six principal response-variation features. Procedure is researcher supplied and known in the literature; no autonomous invention or global design optimum is claimed.
methods.composition_primary_comparator: competent_generalist uses ordinary numerical baseline plus the same sensor-design procedure. fixed_sensor_ablation is not the headline competent-generalist comparison.

acceptance.independent_check: Independent flux-stencil application, not the assembled sparse matrix multiply used by the solver
acceptance.discrete_bound: alpha=(kx+ky)*4*sin(pi/(2*(n+1)))^2/h^2 + reaction*min(reaction_field). Since contrast term is PSD, ||u-u_hat||_2 <= ||residual||_2/alpha. Relative bound divides by ||u_hat|| minus the absolute bound when positive. Floating-point numerical certificate, not interval-verified arithmetic or physical-model error.
acceptance.reference_role: Accurate direct solution is extra research assessment, not a required operational truth oracle. Its time is retained separately; operational residual checking is included in each complete serve time.
acceptance.inverse_mission: Recover the correct one of 16 specified candidate conductivity pairs from noisy sampled fields, with every forward field independently accepted
acceptance.inverse_limits: Finite synthetic candidate identification; no continuous inverse-problem generalization, actual measurement trial or physical parameter recovery claim

splits.confirmation: Owner supplies distinct seed after source/protocol/checkpoint hashes are frozen; thermal uses seed, transfer seed+1, OOD seed+2, inverse seed+3
splits.confirmation_repeats: At least 24 independent cases per field family; recommended 64 for precise paired timing. Composition max(12,count/2) independent inverse instances.
splits.ood: Low x conductivity, high y conductivity, higher local contrast/reaction, sharp and displaced sources. Report negative transfer and every correction.
splits.inverse_conditions: Even indexed trials: 2 sensors and noise SD 5% of peak true field. Odd indexed trials: 6 sensors and 1.8%. Conditions declared before confirmation and reported separately.

resource_accounting.warmup: Fixed public input warms code paths; shared environment warmup excluded from comparative serving latency
resource_accounting.paired_order: Rotate method order by case index
resource_accounting.per_outcome: Assembly + solver-specific setup + initial approximation and exact correction + independent residual check
resource_accounting.recipient_setup: Load checkpoint and project four affine operators once; recorded by version and charged separately
resource_accounting.same_resources: Same processor thread, input cases, discretization, final accuracy and correction iteration cap. Full attained time is charged; methods do not receive extra forward problems or hidden information.
resource_accounting.composition: All policies pay for the same 16 forward parameter candidates and their own sensor-design/inference work. Shared measured forward executions avoid redundant benchmark work but full costs are allocated to every arm.
resource_accounting.time_limits: No latency threshold tuned from confirmation. Any economically feasible latency boundary is derived descriptively after complete costs; not a prospectively validated service-level claim.
resource_accounting.unknown_costs: Assistant authoring, problem selection and research review labor were not instrumented and must not be silently priced at zero. Enterprise monetization remains an explicit scenario.

development_history.iteration_1: technical_dev: original run; rank44 selected. Six-sensor inverse missions all reached success, exposing an uninformative ceiling. Original outcomes remain unchanged.
development_history.iteration_2: technical_dev_iteration2: explicit environment, discrete error bound, stronger numerical router, field retention and 2/6-sensor conditions. Retained unchanged.
development_history.iteration_3: technical_dev_final: metering-only correction adds founder verification/artifact-write charges, process CPU seconds and one-time domain/warmup setup. Same four candidates, identical checkpoint hashes and selected rank; no new scientific candidate search.
